name: Tinker Duobombers builds a second Spider Bomb (#3120)
contract: Duobombers 707258 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER +1 on SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (DBC EffectBasePoints 0, DieSides 1) with class mask word1 0x08000004, which covers Build: Spider Bomb 500535 (SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x08000004). AscensionTinkerSummons.cpp:135-136 reads count = max(1, Effects[EFFECT_1].CalcValue(player)), and Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers applies SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 to effect index 1, so effect 1's value goes from 1 to 2 and the loop at AscensionTinkerSummons.cpp:151 summons creature entry 226012 twice instead of once. Spider Bombs despawn after 15 s and 500535 has an 18 s cooldown, so the second cast starts from an empty field.

steps.label: Build: Spider Bomb asks for one bomb
One Spider Bomb without the talent
Duobombers raises the summon count to two
The build is off cooldown again
